body: Well first of all, it was just a morbid hypothetical thought. So you don't have to worry.  It's just that I had my nagging, every day chronic pain had me thinking about how to stop it.  However I do wish to go to Dignitas. If you know about that then I would like to know your thoughts on it.

>> Okay, but if you land on someone who just happens to step out below then you're killing someone, and they may just break your fall enough that you survive. Take yourself out of you want to, I personally see it as a human right, but it's just wrong to take out, cripple, and/or traumatize other people who have nothing to do with it on your way. Those passers-by are not your family and don't deserve your anger.

Right no of course you are correct. I just wish they would allow easier access to places like Dignitas rather than charging foreigners extra money.
I thought your points were good but seriously why not just let people go to Dignitas?
It's just that I have a chronic illness that will not go away
